tokens.name: midnight-900
tokens.usage: Brand primary. Primary button fill, app header, active progress segments, links. As text on surface, surface-card and midnight-100 (12.9:1).

tokens.name: midnight-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of midnight-900 fills; the focus ring (8.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: midnight-100
tokens.usage: Selected chip, current step background, secondary button fill. Text on it: midnight-900 or ink.

tokens.name: on-midnight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on midnight-900 / midnight-700 fills (13.7:1).

tokens.name: sunshine-400
tokens.usage: The 'Best value' badge and deal highlights. Only ever a FILL with ink text on it (11.5:1) — never text or icons on light grounds.

tokens.name: sunshine-100
tokens.usage: Tint behind the best-value offer card and deal rows. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background (warm off-white).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, inputs, the trip summary bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card outlines, dividers. Not for controls.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and chip outlines — anything a person must find to tap (3.6:1 on surface-card).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and prices on surface, surface-card, sunshine-400, sunshine-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface, surface-card, sunshine-100, midnight-100 (≥5.7:1).

tokens.name: savings
tokens.usage: Savings deltas ('−€84 vs avg'), success states, completed steps. Text on surface-card or savings-100.

tokens.name: savings-100
tokens.usage: Tint behind savings text and success messages.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and 'price went up'. Text on surface-card or danger-100; always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-100
tokens.usage: Tint behind error messages.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Scarcity and caution ('Only 2 rooms left'). Text on surface-card or warning-100.

tokens.name: warning-100
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning messages.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links — alias of midnight-900.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element — alias of midnight-700.

tokens.name: photo-wash-top
tokens.usage: Top of the midnight wash over a hero photo (midnight-900 at 55%): keeps the greeting readable.

tokens.name: photo-wash-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the hero wash (midnight-900 at 25%): lets the photo show through.

tokens.name: photo-wash-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the hero wash (midnight-900 at 92%): carries the white section header that sits on it.

tokens.name: photo-fade
tokens.usage: Bottom of the dark fade on photo cards (ink at 85%), from transparent: city and meta stay readable on any photo.

tokens.name: on-photo-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on photos and on the hero wash (white at 85%).

tokens.name: frost-fill
tokens.usage: Frosted control on a photo, e.g. the avatar on the hero (white at 18%).

tokens.name: frost-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around a frosted control on a photo (white at 35%).

tokens.name: on-photo-track
tokens.usage: Steps still to do in a progress track drawn on a photo (white at 30%).

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The faint dot grid behind Home's content below the hero (border-strong at 22%): paper texture, not graph paper.

tokens.name: glass-fallback
tokens.usage: Where Apple's Liquid Glass isn't available (before iOS 26, Android): the frosted panel's fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only, on a photo.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: destination name, step hero.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Trip total in the summary bar and booking screen. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: delta
styles.usage: Savings delta under a price, in savings color.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon ↔ label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks, gap between price and delta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Step header top padding, hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list items, progress segments' container.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the summary bar's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, avatars, progress segments.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Selected offer card, hover on desktop.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Sticky trip summary bar and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: Photo cards on Home (postcards, bento tiles, the new-waypoint card, been-there stamps): a tight contact shadow plus a long soft one.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: progress-h
tokens.usage: Height of a progress segment.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the step column on desktop.

tokens.name: home-hero-h
tokens.usage: Height of Home's photo hero, under the status bar.

tokens.name: postcard-w
tokens.usage: Width of a trip postcard in Home's rail.

tokens.name: postcard-h
tokens.usage: Height of a trip postcard and of the new-waypoint card.

tokens.name: postcard-overlap
tokens.usage: How far the postcard rail overlaps the bottom of the hero.

tokens.name: new-card-w
tokens.usage: Width of the dashed new-waypoint card at the end of the rail.

tokens.name: bento-row-h
tokens.usage: Row height of the inspiration bento grid; a tall tile spans two rows.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: Diameter of a been-there photo stamp.

tokens.name: dot-grid-gap
tokens.usage: Spacing of the dot grid behind Home's content.

tokens.name: dot-r
tokens.usage: Radius of one dot in that grid.

tokens.name: glow-sun-ry
tokens.usage: Vertical radius of the sunshine glow under Home's hero (top-right).

tokens.name: glow-midnight-ry
tokens.usage: Vertical radius of the midnight-100 glow lower-left on Home.

tokens.name: glow-midnight-y
tokens.usage: How far below the hero the midnight-100 glow is centred.

tokens.name: profile-panel-w
tokens.usage: Width of the profile panel the avatar grows into on Home.

tokens.name: dot-fade-h
tokens.usage: How far down the dot grid fades out to nothing, from the top of the paper.
